text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Eeny, meeny, miny, moe...♪ Catch a tiger 
by the toe...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
...Well, today's my day off, so I was just 
wondering what I should do.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
And then, so many things I wanted to do 
just kept popping into my head~.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I was wondering whether to go eat 
something tasty, or if I really should go 
for a run...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Back in Hokkaido, the only place we could 
go on days off was the nearby ranch... 
Ehehe.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Say, if you don't mind, could you give me 
some advice?
choice_data_list: You ought to eat something delicious.
Let's visit every place we can think of!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Say, if you don't mind, could you give me 
some advice?
choice_data_list: You ought to eat something delicious.
Let's visit every place we can think of!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Right?! Alright, let's head into town and 
eat a whole bunch of food!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much for the advice! Ehehe, 
I wonder what I should eat first...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Hamburg steak or ramen... Eeny, meeny, 
miny, moe――

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Ohh, I see! Wow, you can even do stuff 
like that in the big city!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Over there, the play spots were so far 
apart from each other... Ahaha!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Whoops! This is no time to be hesitating. 
We'd just be wasting precious time!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
All right, I'll do my best to visit every 
single one! Thank you so much for the 
advice!

With those words, Special Week 
energetically dashed off.
